verdict.rationale: Gide's own Venture & Growth Tech page says it advises on financing transactions 'from seed capital to IPOs' and at 'all stages of a growth company's development'. It also states deal volume: more than 70 transactions a year and over €9.2 billion raised or invested over 18 years. A Chambers Band 1 Venture Capital ranking, quoted on the same page, adds support. Missing for 10: named representative financing-round transactions (the only cited deal is an M&A exit), explicit description of priced equity round structuring and late-stage rounds as distinct from IPOs, and independent corroboration beyond the firm's own pages.
